sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Sheer pleasure and enjoyment for you- as you set about to enjoy life to the fullest. Don't make investments in haste-Losses are certain if you don't look at investments from all possible angles. A dispute is likely to occur between family members regarding money matters. You should advise all family members to be clear about finances and cashflow. Travel will be beneficial but expensive. After a bad phase of misunderstanding, the day will bless you with the love of your spouse in the evening.

readings.text: You would probably prefer not to have to worry about money, especially this week. But since it's a necessary part of life, you prefer to worry about broader things - that which you can't control. At this time, your money life is more ideas than reality, thanks to aspects happening in the area of your chart associated with past lives, institutions, the unconscious mind, and dreams. Your efforts to make any serious changes to your money situation now may need more time to develop.

readings.text: Do you feel a bit like a yo-yo sometimes? You may feel especially uneasy with today's planetary alignment. Well, it's important for you to know how to step back from a situation and let time work things out. Consider practicing yoga or going for a long run. This way you will feel like you have done what you can do for the day, instead of worrying about how to change things you really have no control over.

ac.text: Romantic connections could feel somewhat restrictive, dearest Taurus, as the Scorpio Sun and Pluto square off. With your closest companions, consider setting new ground rules to promote teamwork and sustain harmonious bonds. These vibes may also bring revelations about matters of the heart, making you wonder whether it's time to strike out on your own. However, the prospect of rebuilding might leave you feeling paralyzed. Luckily, the Moon moves through your sign to provide reassurance, asking you to nurture your inner light before making any major decisions. A restless energy finds you when Luna squares Mars this evening, but rest and healthy activities will restore your equilibrium.
